title: GenICam Standard Features Naming Convention v2.8
scope: the acquisition features acquire drives; level/unit are the standard's own
note: level R = required by the standard, O = optional. unit follows SFNC 1.2 Standard Units; Gain has none.

PixelFormat.desc: Format of the pixels provided by the device.

Width.desc: Width of the image provided by the device (in pixels).

Height.desc: Height of the image provided by the device (in pixels).

OffsetX.desc: Horizontal offset from the origin to the region of interest (in pixels).

OffsetY.desc: Vertical offset from the origin to the region of interest (in pixels).

AcquisitionMode.desc: Sets the acquisition mode of the device.

AcquisitionStart.desc: Starts the Acquisition of the device.

AcquisitionStop.desc: Stops the Acquisition of the device at the end of the current Frame.

AcquisitionFrameRate.desc: Controls the acquisition rate (in Hertz) at which the frames are

TriggerSelector.desc: Selects the type of trigger to configure.

TriggerMode.desc: Controls if the selected trigger is active.

TriggerSource.desc: Specifies the internal signal or physical input Line to use as the trigger

TriggerActivation.desc: Specifies the activation mode of the trigger.

ExposureMode.desc: Sets the operation mode of the Exposure.

ExposureTime.desc: Sets the Exposure time when ExposureMode is Timed and

ExposureAuto.desc: Sets the automatic exposure mode when ExposureMode is Timed.

GainSelector.desc: Selects which Gain is controlled by the various Gain features.

Gain.desc: Controls the selected gain as an absolute physical value.

GainAuto.desc: Sets the automatic gain control (AGC) mode.

BlackLevel.desc: Controls the analog black level as an absolute physical value.

DeviceVendorName.desc: Name of the manufacturer of the device.

DeviceFirmwareVersion.desc: Version of the firmware in the device.

PayloadSize.desc: Provides the number of bytes transferred for each data buffer or chunk

TimestampLatch.desc: Latches the current timestamp counter into TimestampLatchValue.

TimestampLatchValue.desc: Returns the latched value of the timestamp counter.

ReverseX.desc: Flip horizontally the image sent by the device.

ReverseY.desc: Flip vertically the image sent by the device.

BinningHorizontal.desc: Number of horizontal photo-sensitive cells to combine together.

BinningVertical.desc: Number of vertical photo-sensitive cells to combine together.
